async def act(page):
    # Select the Android template by finding the radio button associated with the Android preview link
    android_preview = page.get_by_role('link', name='Preview', url='https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/project-templates/android')
    # Use filter to find the radio button in the same context; assuming it's a sibling or nearby element
    await page.get_by_role('radio', name='Use template').filter(has=android_preview).click()
    # Wait for any dynamic updates after template selection
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Brief wait to ensure UI updates
    # Fill the project name
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name').fill('web_agent_android_xl')
    # Click the 'Create project' button
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Create project').click()
